The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim.
